Yes, and to change I followed even fatter people around the grocery store each week and vowed to not eat anything they put in their basket (frozen food and soft drinks is what they always buy). Been there in my mid 20's, 315+ lbs at 6'2". Changed my diet, Keto. And started hitting the gym. Got down to 186 and then bulked up to low 200's. In my late 30's now and still hitting the gym 4-5 days a week and eating Keto.

I'm a vegetarian so my exact diet might not work for you, but I used to fight with my weight all the time until I figured out what works for me. Maybe it'll work for you.

I basically eat 4 times a day, big, little, big, little. For breakfast I love to make a tofu scramble, so that'll be about 1/3 block of tofu with some onion and pepper and spices and a drop of soy sauce, with a half a pita bread.

For lunch (you're not gonna like this) I eat a protein bar. I get the ones from Walmart that cost $7.99 for a box of 6. They make the hungry go away and I don't get sleepy in the afternoon, plus my wallet is much happier that I'm not spending so much going out to eat with my co-workers. If I'm really in a rush I'll drink a Slimfast or an Ensure instead of the protein bar. I just leave all that stuff in my locker at work.

Dinner is a stir fry of veggies with either a veggie burger or veggie dog mixed in. Any veggies are good, and any spices you like are fine too but try to stay away from any kind of prepared sauces. A little olive oil and garlic salt is always tasty, or a sprinkle of curry powder. Alternatively (if you're not in the mood to cook) get one of those all-in-one bags of salad with the dressing and crunchies. If you don't need all the dressing don't use it all because that's where most of the calories are.

For snack either a handful of trail mix or cut up a fruit.

I also drink black coffee or tea or hot water with lemon all day long.

That's it. Once you adapt to this diet you won't feel hungry and you'll definitely lose weight. You can easily substitute skinless chicken or other lean meat for the tofu or veggie burger.

I also try to do some yoga stretching in the morning and some situps, and at night I do about 30 minutes of jogging motion at walking speed. This is all a routine now and my weight doesn't vary any more.. I'm 182cm (5' 11") and weigh 82.5kg (182 lbs), and it never varies any more. It's a bit of a boring routine but that's a small price to pay to have a body I'm happy with. Even so, according to this calculator I'm still 25lbs overweight, but I've been lighter and I felt weak. This weight suits me.

I needed to lose weight. I cut out bread, cake, sugar, milk (drinking calories), potatoes, rice, pasta.

I eat meat, fish, eggs, fruit, vegetables and (now) a limited amount of bread (a slice a day).

I keep the calories under control too. Aiming for about 1000 a day. The weight is coming off and my clothes no longer fit.

Plus I am less lethargic and moody (diet related perhaps?)
